advanced.name: Advanced / Experimental
advanced.description: Optional high-resolution global sources. WeatherNext 3 requires a Google allowlist approval and a service account; CAMS UV requires a free ADS token (https://ads.atmosphere.copernicus.eu).

data.wn_gcp_project_id: GCP project ID (used for Requester-Pays-free statistics reads)
data.wn_service_account_json: Service-account JSON (paste the full key file content)
data.enable_pkg_solar: Solar package (irradiance, direct beam, cloud layers)
data.enable_pkg_wind: Wind package (100 m wind speed and direction)
data.enable_pkg_probability: Probability package (24 h rain / frost / heat risk)

data_description.wn_service_account_json: Stored outside config entry options; leave empty to keep the currently stored key.
data_description.cams_api_token: Format 'user@host:key'. Leave empty to keep the currently stored token.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Rainradar configuration is allowed.

error.invalid_service_account_json: Not a valid Google service-account JSON (missing client_email).
error.service_account_required: WeatherNext requires a service-account JSON key.
error.allowlist_pending: WeatherNext access not granted yet — submit the Google data request form and wait for approval (5-7 days).
error.invalid_service_account: Google rejected the service account (bad key or no storage scope).
error.http_500: Google Cloud Storage returned a server error; try again later.
error.no_data_found: No WeatherNext data found for the last 8 hours.
error.cams_token_required: CAMS UV requires an ADS API token.
error.invalid_token_format: The ADS token should look like 'user@example.com:secretkey'.
